register_llama_models: register all Llama 3.1 and 3.2 models including base, instruct, and vision variants
register_llama_3_1_models: register Llama 3.1 base and instruct models with 8B size and supported quantization types
register_llama_3_2_models: register Llama 3.2 base and instruct models with 1B and 3B sizes
register_llama_3_2_vision_models: register Llama 3.2 vision models with 11B and 90B multimodal support
run_main_script: run the script to validate registered Llama models against the model registry
